title: Order relative to authorizing the joint committee on Health Care Financing to make an investigation and study of a certain current Senate documents relative to assisted living residencies in the Commonwealth.

abstracts.abstract: Senate, July 16, 2026 -- The committee on Health Care Financing, to whom was referred the petitions (accompanied by bill, Senate, No. 3057) (subject to Joint Rule 12) of Patricia D. Jehlen for legislation relative to assisted living residencies in the Commonwealth, report the accompanying Order (Senate, No. 3176).
